conventions.test_baseline: 473 passed (tests/quant/decision + tests/architecture + focused runtime/contract suites) at commit 9c078c20
rules: one node per worktree/branch, never two nodes in one worktree
a node may not edit a file owned by another node in the same wave
RED test precedes implementation for every behaviour change (N3, N4)

if a node touches a file not listed in its footprint, stop and extend the footprint first
AI/LLM integration is preserved: quant/llm, quant/decision/timesfm_* stay. Only provably-dead AI paths (quant/sidecars, quant/modeling, timesfm_sizing) are removed
